issues.title: Ambiguous 'AST count' implementation for non-Rust languages
issues.why: While AC-CG-26 provides a brilliant worked example for Rust's match-arm ratio, the 'AST count' logic for EX-08 (Switch/Select dispatch) lacks a similar line-by-line breakdown for Go or TypeScript, leading to potential linter divergence.
issues.fix: Add a worked example for EX-08 showing a Go 'switch' statement line-count calculation similar to the Rust match example.

issues.title: Dangling reference to PowerShell/Research content
issues.why: AC-CG-17 acknowledges these are placeholders but the overview still lists them as 'Files: 0' which can trigger 'missing file' errors in strict AI auditors despite the structural-delegation-pin.
issues.fix: Add a single .gitkeep or stub 00-overview.md to folders 09 and 10 to satisfy file-existence checks.

issues.title: Inconsistent Boolean Prefix List
issues.why: The TypeScript contract in §97 lists ['is', 'has', 'should', 'can', 'will', 'did', 'was'], but the JSON Schema in §01-cross-language adds ['are', 'must', 'needs'].
issues.fix: Synchronize the BOOLEAN_PREFIX_ALLOWLIST in the §97 TS block with the JSON Schema in §01.
